name: McDonald's Holdings Company (Japan), Ltd.
summary: McDonald's Holdings Company (Japan), Ltd. operates a chain of hamburger restaurants in Japan. As of December 31, 2020, it operated 2,924 restaurants. The company was formerly known as Japan McDonald's K.K. and changed its name to McDonald's Holdings Company (Japan), Ltd. in July 2002. McDonald's Holdings Company (Japan), Ltd. was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
